target.required_training: full SFT through an admitted Qwen2-compatible template/runner

findings: The public Together fine-tuning supported-model table checked on 2026-08-22 lists no Qwen2/Qwen2.5 base model.

The previous launcher default Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo is visible as an inference model but is not documented in the current supported fine-tuning table; inference visibility is not training-template admission evidence.
Together BYOM requires the external Hugging Face checkpoint to match the Together base architecture, with a suitably close size/context envelope.
The current estimate-price endpoint does not accept from_hf_model or hf_model_revision, so a successful price estimate cannot establish BYOM checkpoint compatibility.
The actual create API and current Together Python SDK support from_hf_model plus hf_model_revision; actual checkpoint acceptance is therefore a later authenticated create/admission gate.
Together currently documents a USD 4 minimum fine-tune charge; the campaign remains protected by the repository USD 18 single-job ceiling.

unusual_experiment.name: template_mirage_qwen35_08b_substitution
unusual_experiment.counter_reality: Use the currently documented smallest Qwen full-fine-tune base, Qwen3.5-0.8B, as the Together BYOM template for Qwen2.5-0.5B merely because vendor family and parameter size are close.
unusual_experiment.candidate_structural_difference: multimodal conditional-generation wrapper with a Qwen3.5 text stack and materially different vocabulary/attention configuration
unusual_experiment.reason: BYOM architecture matching is a hard contract; parameter-count proximity does not override architecture mismatch. Silent Qwen3.5 substitution would change the research question rather than unblock the 0.5B campaign.

launcher_changes: require explicit currently verified Qwen2-compatible template
pin primary and ablation Hugging Face revisions
classify estimate-price as budget/data/template evidence only

current_blocker: No currently documented Qwen2/Qwen2.5 Together full-fine-tuning template is available. Compatibility remains blocked until an authenticated model_limits/create admission proves a Qwen2-compatible Together template, or the same 0.5B campaign is moved to another owner-admitted full-FT runner without changing the target model.
next_discriminator: With an execution-environment Together secret and a currently verified Qwen2-compatible template name, run the non-billed launcher preflight first. Do not create or retry a billed job blindly. If no Qwen2-compatible Together template exists, retain Qwen2.5-0.5B and change only the training runner, not the research target.
